original_target.title: Global classical continuation for a reversible mass-action reaction

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original is deterministic Neumann reaction–diffusion for one disjoint-species reversible reaction of arbitrary positive integer order, dimension and diffusivities. Agresti–Kniely–Tang Proposition6.5 requires all diffusivities above a threshold; their principal result adds chosen transport noise on a torus. Quadratic/low-dimensional classical theorems, renormalized weak solutions and spatially homogeneous mass-action permanence do not settle arbitrary-order classical continuation. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
